cooling.title: Cooling
cooling.how_to: Tap a tile, then tap its neighbor to swap. Line up three or more of a color to clear them. Tiles rise from below to fill the gap. Keep the heat down.
cooling.how_to_keyboard: Click a pair to swap it. Arrows move the cursor, space or enter swaps with the piece to the right.
cooling.special.charge_help: Swap it to blast a 3 by 3 hole.
cooling.special.magnet_help: Swap it with a piece to pull every piece of that kind off the board.
cooling.special.slag_help: Can't be matched. It rides up with the board and comes off on its own once it's above the heat line.
cooling.hint_note: Practice rounds point at a scoring swap if you stop for a few seconds.

engines.title: Engines
engines.how_to: Pairs of plasma, ion and fusion pellets fall into the drive core. Drag left and right to steer, even under an injector, tap the piece to turn it, hold a swipe down to hurry it. Fill every outlined target on an injector with its color to fire it, and line up four of a kind in a row. Block the entry at the top and the core flames out: it is cleared for a penalty.
engines.how_to_keyboard: Left and right arrows steer, up and down turn either way, hold space to hurry.
engines.legend_injector: An injector: a bar, a stack, an L or a square. Fill each outlined cell with its color to fire it; blank cells hold anything. Pellets rest on its shelves and slide in from the side.
plating.title: Plating
plating.how_to: Three plates wait in the tray. Drag one onto the hull and let go to set it down; the buttons under it turn it either way, flip it, and the welder welds it down. Drag it off the hull to send it back, or tap the hull to move it there. Cover every cell of a breach to seal it. Plates hanging over sound hull or over each other are waste; a breach sealed with no waste and no extra plates is flawless. A breach left alone too long glows, then widens.
plating.how_to_keyboard: Move the mouse to carry a plate and click to weld it; right-click or scroll turns it, F flips it. 1, 2, 3 pick a plate, arrows move it, R turns, Q turns back, F flips, H jumps to the best fit, enter welds it down, escape puts it back.
plating.legend_breaches: Dark cells are breaches. Fill every cell of a breach; cells left idle too long widen it, and a widened breach can't be flawless.
plating.legend_brush: Lines on a plate show its brushing. Seal a breach with every plate brushed across it for a bonus.
gunnery.title: Gunnery
gunnery.how_to: Pieces drop from the feeder and roll until something turns them; anything you don't steer rolls out a hatch. Every round is on a different deck. Steer them into the turrets with arrows: cell, then sabot, then slug, and the turret fires. Fire all four turrets for a broadside. A wrong piece jams a turret until coolant flushes it out. Tap or click toward an edge of a deck tile to point an arrow that way, or swipe across it; do it again to lift it.
gunnery.how_to_keyboard: Arrow keys move the cursor. W, A, S, D lay an arrow that way; Space or Backspace lifts it.
gunnery.legend_broadside: Fire every turret for a broadside: a turret's lamp lights when it fires, and when all four are lit the broadside scores {points} and the lamps go out.
gunnery.legend_order: Each turret takes a cell, then a sabot, then a slug, and fires when full. A wrong piece jams it; only coolant gets into a jammed turret, and flushes it clear.
gunnery.legend_arrow: An arrow turns any piece that rolls onto it. There is no limit on arrows; right-click lifts one.
gunnery.legend_badges: The badge on a turret is the piece it wants next; the pips below show its load. When a piece is headed into a turret its route lights up: green if the turret wants it, red if it will jam it.
navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.how_to: Stars fall from the sky into the top of the star chart and come to rest against the first star they meet, or at the center. Stars always pack toward the center: turn a ring so a slot opens under a star and it slides in. Drag a ring to turn it, or tap its right side to turn it clockwise and its left side to turn it back. Tap the falling star to bring it down now. A star on the hollow marker of its shape and color fills it; fill every marker and the constellation is charted. Three loose stars of a kind in a row clear.
navigation.how_to_keyboard: Up and down pick a ring, left and right turn it, enter or space brings the star down.
navigation.lost_heading_note: If the outer slot at the top is taken when a star arrives, the whole column is swept away and it costs points. Keep the top open.
navigation.hint_note: Practice rounds show a hint when you pause: the ring to turn, and which way.
navigation.setting_markers_hint: Hide it to test your memory.
navigation.legend_marker: A hollow marker wants a star of its shape and color. Markers stay put; stars ride their ring and slide inward when the slot under them opens.
navigation.legend_landing: The ring at the end of the falling star's path is where it lands: gold when that spot is its own marker, red when the column is blocked.
navigation.legend_runs: Three or more loose stars of one kind in a row, around a ring or down a column, clear for a few points. Stars on their markers never clear this way.

home.practice_battle_blurb: Plot four moves a turn, catch the raider broadside, and board her when she's hurt. Four minutes.
battle.title: Space Battle
battle.how_to: Each turn you get movement tokens: left, forward, right. Tap a slot, then a token, to plot up to four moves; a turn carries the ship forward one cell and swings her 90 degrees. Tap a plotted move to take it back, or the backspace button for the last one. Tap the port or starboard side of a slot to fire that broadside after the move; every shot uses one loaded turret. Solar currents carry a ship a cell, gravity wells spin her, asteroids and ramming cost hull. When the clock runs out the plot flies as it stands, and the raider flies hers at the same time. Hit her until she's hurt, then end a move alongside with the grapple set to board her.
battle.how_to_keyboard: A, W and D queue left, forward and right. Q and E arm the port and starboard turrets on the last slot. Backspace takes back the last move, escape clears the plot, G toggles the grapple, enter flies the plot now.

home.practice_swordfight_blurb: Drop pairs, fuse slabs, shatter them with breakers and bury the raider in scrap. The main event.
swordfight.title: Swordfighting
swordfight.how_to: Pairs of blocks fall into your board. Drag left and right to steer, tap to turn, hold a swipe down to hurry. Blocks of one color that make a rectangle fuse into a slab, and a slab grows by whole rows and columns. A breaker is a block with a blade on it: when it comes to rest touching its color, everything of that color joined to it shatters, slabs and all, and whatever falls into place may set off the next breaker. Shattering sends scrap to the raider: grey blocks that fall in the pattern of your blade and ripen into colors after a few drops. Fill the raider's entry and they're beaten; let yours fill and you are.
swordfight.how_to_keyboard: Left and right arrows steer, up and X turn clockwise, down and Z the other way, hold space to hurry.

swordfight.legend_breaker: A breaker carries a blade. Set it down touching its color and everything of that color joined to it shatters.
swordfight.legend_slab: Blocks of one color in a rectangle fuse into a slab. Bigger slabs are worth far more when they shatter.
swordfight.legend_scrap: Scrap is dead metal and cannot be broken until it ripens, two drops after it lands. After the first drop it shows the color it will turn.
swordfight.legend_blades: A blade is where your scrap lands on the other side: the plasma cutlass spreads it, the arc sabre piles it in the middle, the vibro-dirk at the edges.
